summary: Two hikers in their twenties, one day overdue on an early-season 27-mile Four Pass Loop attempt (set out Sunday, expected to finish Tuesday), were located by a Mountain Rescue Aspen drone near Crater Lake on Wednesday. One hiker's father alerted authorities Wednesday morning after losing contact; the Pitkin County Sheriff's Office tasked Mountain Rescue Aspen, mustering ~10 ground searchers, a helicopter, a fixed-wing aircraft, and the drone. The drone spotted both hikers from ~500 ft altitude; they were uninjured but tired, delayed by deep early-season snow.
location: near Crater Lake, Four Pass Loop, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office / Mountain Rescue Aspen
